title: Notes to Self: Can LLMs Benefit from Experiential Abstractions?
abstract: arXiv:2607.20372v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Humans distill experience into reusable abstractions, e.g., strategies and cautionary reminders, and apply them to gradually solve problems more effectively. We study whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can similarly benefit from such experiential abstractions. From LLMs' solution traces on the MATH training set, a stronger teacher or the LLMs themselves extract natural-language abstractions into a retrievable library. We explore two usage modes: (1) inference-time retrieval and (2) reinforcement learning (RL) with abstraction-augmented training prompts. Experiential abstractions improve LLM performance on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks. Self-extracted abstractions match teacher-extracted ones, and our abstraction usage framework can transfer to other datasets and models. These findings suggest LLMs can extract and apply experiential abstractions much as humans leverage distilled experience.

translated_title: 写给自己的笔记：大语言模型能从经验抽象中受益吗？
translated_abstract: 人类会将经验提炼为可复用的抽象，例如策略和警示性提醒，并应用它们来逐步更有效地解决问题。我们研究大语言模型（LLM）是否也能从这种经验抽象中受益。基于LLM在MATH训练集上的解题轨迹，由一个更强的教师模型或LLM自身将自然语言形式的抽象提取到一个可检索的库中。我们探索了两种使用模式：（1）推理时检索和（2）使用抽象增强训练提示的强化学习（RL）。经验抽象提升了LLM在数学和逻辑推理基准上的表现。自我提取的抽象与教师提取的抽象效果相当，且我们的抽象使用框架可以迁移到其他数据集和模型。这些发现表明，LLM能够像人类利用提炼的经验那样提取和应用经验抽象。
tldr: 该论文提出让LLM从自身或教师模型的解题轨迹中提取自然语言经验抽象并构建可检索库，通过推理时检索或强化学习方式利用这些抽象，显著提升了数学与逻辑推理性能，且自我提取的抽象效果与教师提取的相当，框架还可迁移至其他数据集和模型。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that LLMs can extract natural-language experiential abstractions from their own or a teacher's solution traces into a retrievable library, and leveraging them via inference-time retrieval or RL training improves mathematical and logical reasoning, with self-extracted abstractions matching teacher-extracted ones and the framework transferring across datasets and models.
